newsitem.title: USA: Bankers Trust shareholders approve Alex Brown merger.
newsitem.headline: Bankers Trust shareholders approve Alex Brown merger.

text.p: Bankers Trust New York Corp. shareholders Wednesday approved issuance of 25.96 million shares, effecting the $1.6 billion acquisition of investment bank Alex. Brown Inc.
Alex Brown shareholders later in Baltimore approved the merger of the two firms. The merger is expected to be completed Sept. 1.
Of approximately 59 million Bankers Trust shares voted, 98.7 percent of the shares were voted in favor of the merger, Bankers Trust said.

During the brief Bankers Trust meeting in New York, Chairman Frank Newman was questioned by a shareholder about a recent report that the company's office building at 280 Park Avenue in New York has been sold. Newman declined comment, referring to the report as rumor and "an unconfirmed report." Bankers Trust owns the building and the land.
Newman said Bankers Trust expects all of the necessary approvals for the completion of the merger by the end of July.
In April, Bankers Trust, the nation's seventh largest bank, agreed to buy Baltimore-based Alex Brown in the largest acquisition of a U.S. investment bank by a commercial bank, to date.
Bankers Trust stock closed up $1.75 at $100.31 on the New York Stock Exchange.
